name: Air Fryer Chicken
subtitle: Crisp-skinned chicken thighs with simple seasoning
description: Coat chicken thighs with oil, flour, and seasoning, then air-fry until crisp and safely cooked through.

ingredients.item: or 8 small chicken thighs skin on
seasoning of choice (use salt and pepper
ingredients.preparation: or 1/2-1 tsp of either smoky BBQ, ras-el-hanout, garlic granules, celery salt or garam masala)

instructions.text: Pat the chicken dry. Combine it with the flour and chosen seasoning, then coat with the oil.
Arrange the chicken in a single layer in the air fryer, skin side down if applicable.
Air-fry for 35 minutes, turning the pieces partway through if needed for even browning.
Continue cooking for 10 minutes, until the skin is crisp.
Check the thickest piece with a food thermometer; chicken is ready at 165°F. Rest briefly before serving.
